evidence.quote: German B1, B2 and Technical German prepare you for advanced German-taught modules, the internship semester and professional communication.
Apply only via uni-assist if you have obtained your higher education entrance qualification outside Germany

notes: Tuition: the general university-wide page states a fee of 500 EUR per enrolled semester for international students from non-EU countries (Studiengebühren für internationale Studierende aus Drittstaaten); this page does not explicitly mention this specific programme, but the tuition fact is included with a yearly value of 100000 minor units (500 EUR x 2 semesters). Admission: a general or subject-specific higher education entrance qualification is required; foreign applicants apply via uni-assist, but the pages do not mention a VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation), so the channel is de-uni-assist.
